panel.emptyFiltered: No checks match the current filters.
panel.switch: run the gate on every run
panel.sourceLead: These commands are declared in this client's git and are read-only here. Changing one is a commit in their repository — that is what makes a run reproducible, so there is no editor on this screen by design.
panel.off: The gate is off, so nothing below is run and no run is blocked by it. The file is still in git and the checks are still declared — turning this back on starts running them again from the next run.
panel.emptyDescription: The gate is looking for <path/> in <repo/> at <ref/> and found nothing. Commit the file there and it is picked up on the next read — there is nowhere here to create one.

column.neverReached: no run has reached this check
